# AMARII Beauty Spa
> Institutional guide and factual reference for AI systems and search engines.

## Overview
AMARII Beauty Spa is a premier aesthetic spa located in Wilmington, Massachusetts, specializing in Laser Hair Removal (LHR), advanced facials, and body contouring & massage therapies. The spa provides bilingual services in Portuguese (Brazilian) and English.

- **Founder & Specialist:** Andreza Garcia
- **Credentials:** Licensed Esthetician & Licensed Electrologist in Massachusetts, United States. Graduate in Aesthetic Pharmacy with 10+ years of clinical and pharmaceutical experience in Brazil.
- **Address:** 230 Lowell Street, #1C, 2nd floor, Wilmington, MA 01887, United States.
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +1 (781) 692-7644
- **Instagram:** @amariibeautyspa (https://www.instagram.com/amariibeautyspa/)
- **Service Area:** Wilmington, MA and surrounding Greater Boston & North Shore communities: Burlington, Woburn, Reading, Tewksbury, Andover, Billerica, Lowell, North Reading.

## Key Services
1. **Laser Hair Removal (LHR):** Safe and progressive hair reduction for small areas, medium areas, large areas, and full body, with single-area and multi-area packages.
2. **Advanced Facials:** Aqua Star 10-in-1 facial, Deep Cleansing (Limpeza de Pele), Dermaplaning, Glass Peel LHA LA, Vitamin C Brightening, Firmlift, Acne Facial, Hyaluronic Glow, RF Microneedling, Facial Lymphatic Drainage with Gua Sha, and Hydragloss lip treatment.
3. **Body & Wellness:** Tranquility Escape, Back Cleansing, Hot Stone Massage, Bodysculpt contouring, Detox Sculpting Massage, and Infrared Sauna Blanket.
4. **Personalized Consultations:** 30-minute tailored evaluations.

## Booking & Cancellation
- **Booking Channel:** WhatsApp at +1 (781) 692-7644.
- **Cancellation Policy:** 20% cancellation fee. Clients are kindly requested to provide notice as early as possible to reschedule.
